question:
Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom/phrase from the options:
"Eat humble pie":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **To admit a mistake**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Eat humble pie"** means to admit that you were wrong about something and apologize. (अपनी गलती स्वीकार करना और क्षमा मांगना)

 
 
• **Example:** After realizing his mistake, he had to eat humble pie and apologize to his boss.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **To admit a mistake**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To be very happy** (बहुत खुश होना) - This refers to a state of extreme happiness or joy. 
 
 
• **Example:** She was very happy when she received the job offer.
 
 

 
• **Option 2: To eat something bitter** (कुछ कड़वा खाना) - This means consuming something with a bitter taste, but this is not related to the idiom "eat humble pie."
 
 
• **Example:** He accidentally ate a bitter gourd thinking it was sweet.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: To celebrate a victory** (जीत का जश्न मनाना) - This refers to rejoicing or enjoying after winning something.
 
 
• **Example:** The team celebrated their victory with a grand party.
 
 

47:Tc75,

सही उत्तर है: **विकल्प 4** अर्थात **गलती स्वीकार करना**।
